title: Place server-rendered content inside interactive controls
goal: Project captured non-generic static content into an interactive component without a wrapper; use for cross-render-mode composition, not live callbacks.

selectionNotes: Cross-render-mode static content; not delegate serialization or arbitrary live callbacks.
Non-generic fragments must execute during prerendering. Generic templates and ordinary delegates cannot cross this boundary.

runtime.name: .NET
runtime.reason: The primary route uses .NET 11 framework contracts.

sdk.name: .NET SDK
sdk.reason: Build against .NET 11 reference assemblies; exact RC2 is evidence, not an exact installation requirement.

language.name: C#
language.reason: Declared canonical sample language mode; preview language syntax is not required.

packageAssets: Framework Components/Endpoints/Server assemblies plus SDK-aligned Microsoft.AspNetCore.App.Internal.Assets browser files; no explicit NuGet package or optional workload.
platforms: ASP.NET Core server; actual Windows x64 SSR and Chromium 152 Interactive Server execution. WebAssembly/Auto and other OS execution are not claimed.
renderingModes: Static SSR parent to prerendered Interactive Server child: executed.
WebAssembly/Auto use the framework capture path but require independently verified client assets/types; not executed here.
prerequisites: Use net11.0 with matching ASP.NET Core 11 runtime, SDK/reference assemblies and browser assets. Canonical language mode is C# 15.0; no preview syntax or experimental opt-in.
Enable AddInteractiveServerComponents and AddInteractiveServerRenderMode, keep prerendering enabled, and invoke every supplied fragment during prerendering. The canonical App remains static.
constraints: Cross-render-mode static content; not delegate serialization or arbitrary live callbacks.

Only non-generic RenderFragment parameters are captured. RenderFragment<T> and ordinary delegates are rejected. Captured event handlers and reference captures are skipped with framework warnings; put live behavior in the interactive component.

Do not defer a supplied fragment until after activation: uncaptured fragments fail. No conditional net10.0 route, generic variance migration, WebAssembly/Auto execution, trimming/AOT or GA proof is claimed.
stabilityLimitations: Stable rendering contract tested with .NET 11 RC2; GA reconciliation remains pending. No experimental opt-in.

evidence.scope: Actual older Web SDK consumer compilation. Separate real HTTP/browser execution verifies the wrapper, live counter and direct-fragment refusal. Compilation alone does not prove rendering.

Actual newer Web SDK consumer compilation. Separate real HTTP/browser reports verify named/child capture, interactive rerendering, generic/delegate/prerender restrictions and a skipped captured callback.

humanProof.scope: Required bounded SSR/Interactive Server behavior executed locally without external services or accounts. Other render modes, native platforms and GA execution are outside this proof.
